integrity: The closed-orbit and Floquet-exponent identities are supplied as full analytic proofs and are supplemented by a separately executable algebraic checker. No independent mathematical audit or historical-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem asserts one explicitly constructed hyperbolic circular limit cycle and sharp least degree; it does not assert uniqueness, absence of other cycles, global basin classification, or stability of the invariant unit circle.
The unit circle contains axis stationary points and is not itself a periodic orbit.
The lower-degree obstruction is sourced from published results of Jana–Sarkar; a 2016 general classification was not inspected in full.
title: Sharp quintic realization of a circular attracting limit cycle under an invariant unit circle in Kolmogorov flows
